testCases.title: Verify the sort dropdown is displayed on the product overview page
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
expectedResults: The sort dropdown is displayed on the product overview page.

testCases.title: Verify that the sort dropdown includes the correct options
expectedResults: The sort dropdown includes the options: Name (A - Z), Name (Z - A), Price (High - Low), Price (Low - High).

testCases.title: Verify selecting a sort option reloads the product grid
steps: Select one of the sort options from the dropdown.
expectedResults: The product grid reloads with products ordered according to the selected sort.
